_comment: Sidecar config for frame-screenshots.py (Plan 5 Task 5). Ordered (input, headline) pairs plus per-shot chrome-crop overrides. Edit this file to re-run with new captures/copy - no code changes needed for the common case.

shots.headline: Live quakes worldwide
shots.note: Map + live magnitude-colored pins (cluster counts + single dots) + live feed list underneath, 'All calm near you' status pill, 4.0+ magnitude filter chip, my-location FAB - the core landing pitch. Refreshed on the current-build device pass (98bc1cd8, 2026-08-21) from a fresh assembleDebug install: Inter font throughout, real feed data (Philippines/Myanmar/Flores/Tonga quakes). The Home/Tokyo favorite-place quick-switch chips were added later in this same pass (after a second place existed) and are demonstrated in 06-notification.png instead - they weren't on screen yet when this exact hero frame was captured. crop_top removes the OS status bar (measured: uniform gray band on this device); crop_bottom removes the OS nav row, NOT the app's own Home/History/Insights tab bar, which stays.

shots.headline: Every quake, the full picture
shots.note: Detail sheet depth: magnitude (with a 'revised from M5.3' correction pill - honest about USGS magnitude updates), depth/distance/felt-it stats, honest tsunami line, coordinates, source attribution (USGS - confirmed by EMSC), felt-report count, WhatsApp icon + Share row (real app icons). Refreshed on the current-build device pass (98bc1cd8, 2026-08-21) from a fresh assembleDebug install: real M5.2 Philippines quake data. This particular quake's sheet did not surface an in-app News section (that section is conditional; see 03-insights.png's Strongest card for the same feature elsewhere in this pass).

shots.headline: Trends at a glance
shots.note: Quakes-per-day chart (7-day window, 1,270 total), magnitude breakdown (Low/Moderate/Strong/Major), Strongest card (real M6.9, 15 km NNW of Pematangsiantar, Indonesia). Refreshed on the current-build device pass (98bc1cd8, 2026-08-21) from a fresh assembleDebug install. This pass's data did not surface Insights' 'IN THE NEWS' section (present in earlier passes when GDELT returned headlines for the pictured strongest quake) - confirmed by scrolling to the end of the screen; the space below Strongest is genuinely empty in this capture, not cropped.

shots.headline: Nearby, defined by you
shots.note: Places + Alerts settings - the more-compelling option per this task's either/or choice (vs. a map radius-ring overlay). Shows the Alerts section (nearby-radius slider at 500 km, magnitude-threshold slider, 'Alerts: On' after enabling the OS notification permission live during this pass), the Places section (current coordinates, Change / Use my location / Add place), TerraWatch Plus (Free), and Theme (System/Light/Dusk). Refreshed on the current-build device pass (98bc1cd8, 2026-08-21) from a fresh assembleDebug install; filename kept as 04-settings-radius-ring.png for pipeline stability even though the radius-ring map visual wasn't the option chosen this pass.

shots.headline: The full quake archive
shots.note: History list with All/4.0+/5.0+/6.0+ magnitude filters, 2026/2025/All year filters, and a search field, plus a populated month section underneath. Refreshed on the current-build device pass (98bc1cd8, 2026-08-21) from a fresh assembleDebug install, with the 6.0+ filter selected instead of All - a stronger store shot (real 7.7/6.9/6.7/6.1/6.1/6.0 quakes: Ende Indonesia, Pematangsiantar Indonesia, Aniso Peru, Port-Olry Vanuatu, Ende Indonesia, South Sandwich Islands) that still shows the identical filter chrome.

shots.headline: Switch cities in a tap
shots.note: Home/Tokyo favorite-place quick-switch chips over the live map (Greater Tokyo, real OSM labels), feed sheet peeking underneath. Refreshed on the current-build device pass (98bc1cd8, 2026-08-21): re-captured from a fresh assembleDebug install specifically to check the notification shade for a real TerraWatch digest alert first (per this pass's brief) - none was present (notifications had just been enabled this same session, so AlertDigestWorker's periodic job hadn't fired yet), and faking one was explicitly out of bounds. Substituted this honest, compelling alternative instead (favorites quick-switch chips, explicitly pre-approved as a fallback), so crop_top/crop_bottom now match the other five app-content shots (uniform status-bar/nav-bar crop) rather than the old notification-shade shot's crop_top=0/crop_bottom=0 (that variant had no OS chrome to crop; this one does).
